data: Linked annotations, sheet zoom and clearer selection
Edit a shared annotation from Notes or the grid, zoom sheets and preview range drags.

See and edit annotations from either pane. Option-drag selected note text to the grid to create a linked annotation. Click the text in Notes or open the annotation from the grid to edit it. The Notes footer shows how many annotations are on the sheet. Notes and annotations.

Read formatted Notes and return from linked cells. Headings, emphasis and escaped punctuation render in place. Hover over a live value to see its source. After following a link, press ⌃⌘← to return to the note selection and scroll position. Notes guide.

Resize and zoom each sheet. Column dividers show a grip on hover, and the Notes divider is easier to grab. Sheet zoom scales text and grid controls and is remembered per sheet. Grid guide.

See what a range drag will do. Selection and fill show dimensions. Drag a selected range’s border to move it, or hold Option to copy it. Scratch previews the destination and any shifted formulas. Selection guide.
